scripts.dev: pnpm run build:packages && turbo run dev --filter="./apps/*"
scripts.db:status: sqlite3 ~/.kiban/database/kiban.sqlite "select role, count(*) from users group by role;"
scripts.db:reset:dev: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p=require('node:os').homedir()+'/.kiban/database/kiban.sqlite'; if (fs.existsSync(p)) { fs.rmSync(p); console.log('Deleted '+p); } else { console.log('No database at '+p); }"
